identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of the Efficacy and Safety of Bevacizumab in Chinese Women With Newly Diagnosed, Previously Untreated Stage III or Stage IV Epithelial Ovarian, Fallopian Tube, or Primary Peritoneal Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase III Trial of Carboplatin and Paclitaxel Plus Placebo Versus Carboplatin Paclitaxel Plus Concurrent and Extended Bevacizumab in Chinese Women With Newly Diagnosed, Previously Untreated, Stage III or Stage IV Epithelial Ovarian, Fallopian Tube, or Primary Peritoneal Cancer

armGroups.label: Bevacizumab + Paclitaxel + Carboplatin
armGroups.description: Participants will receive paclitaxel, carboplatin intravenous (IV) infusion on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle for a total of 6 cycles. Bevacizumab IV infusion will start at Cycle 2 for 5 cycles, followed by maintenance therapy up to a maximum of 22 cycles or until disease progression, unacceptable toxicity, or withdrawal, whichever occurs first.

armGroups.label: Placebo + Paclitaxel + Carboplatin
armGroups.description: Participants will receive paclitaxel, carboplatin IV infusion on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle for a total of 6 cycles. Placebo IV infusion will start at Cycle 2 for 5 cycles, followed by maintenance therapy up to a maximum of 22 cycles or until disease progression, unacceptable toxicity, or withdrawal, whichever occurs first.

interventions.name: Paclitaxel
interventions.description: 175 mg/m\^2 IV infusion on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle.

interventions.name: Bevacizumab
interventions.description: 15 mg/kg IV infusion on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle.

interventions.name: Carboplatin
interventions.description: Area Under the Curve (AUC) of 6 mg/ml/min on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle.

interventions.name: Placebo
interventions.description: Placebo matched to bevacizumab IV infusion on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle.
